# BYZ scope. Calm enough for this line's events (design 3.2): no civil war, no theme revolt, no Byzantine intrigue.
oe_bey_calm = {
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
    oe_bi_active = no
}
# BYZ scope. The Ottomans exist and the house of Osman has not joined the empire (every Ottoman event and step).
oe_bey_ott_ok = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } }
# BYZ scope. Can pay $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_bey_can_pay = { gold >= { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
# Country scope (an emirate). It counts toward the counterweight (牵制, design 3.9): not the Ottomans' subject, on the
# Ottoman border (theirs or a subject's) and not hostile to the empire.
oe_bey_cw_one = {
    country_exists = c:TUR
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    NOT = { tag = TUR }
    NOT = { is_subject_of = c:TUR }
    OR = {
        is_neighbor_of = c:TUR
        any_neighbor_country = { is_subject_of = c:TUR }
    }
    opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 0 }
}

# ---- phase 2
# Country scope (an emirate). It is there to be brought under the sultan: AI, nobody's subject (so never the empire's
# or Timur's), and the Ottomans exist. The test buttons ask for no more than this (oe_bey_dev_force).
oe_bey_sub_who = {
    country_exists = c:TUR
    NOT = { tag = TUR }
    is_ai = yes
    is_subject = no
}
# Country scope (an emirate). The sultan can bring it under the Ottomans without a war of ours (design 3.4): at peace,
# not the empire's ally, on the Ottoman border (theirs or a subject's), and the Ottoman army three times its own.
oe_bey_can_submit = {
    oe_bey_sub_who = yes
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    at_war = no
    NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = c:BYZ } }
    OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:TUR any_neighbor_country = { is_subject_of = c:TUR } }
    army_size <= oe_bey_tur_army_third
}
# Country scope (Karaman, W-8). The same, with the Ottoman army only twice its own.
oe_bey_can_submit_kar = {
    oe_bey_sub_who = yes
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    at_war = no
    NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = c:BYZ } }
    OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:TUR any_neighbor_country = { is_subject_of = c:TUR } }
    army_size <= oe_bey_tur_army_half
}
# Country scope (an emirate). What the steps W-6 to W-8 check for each country when they run: the rule above, or just
# "in place" while a test button forces the step.
oe_bey_sub_go = { OR = { oe_bey_can_submit = yes AND = { oe_bey_sub_who = yes c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_bey_dev_force } } } }
oe_bey_sub_go_kar = { OR = { oe_bey_can_submit_kar = yes AND = { oe_bey_sub_who = yes c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_bey_dev_force } } } }
# BYZ scope. Timur holds the Ottoman sultan (B3: the interregnum's own flag, or its trigger where the interregnum could
# not begin), first seen in 1400-1410. A test button can say so at any date.
oe_bey_cap_seen = {
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_bey_dev_captured
        AND = {
            var:oe_bey_m >= 757
            var:oe_bey_m <= 888
            OR = { has_variable = oe_ivr_captured oe_ivr_sultan_captured = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The chronicle row (gen_chronicle.py, key bey). Void: the emirates were gone from before the empire's eyes
# before 1348 (design 4.4). Done: the line is closed (1446.1.1). Running: an event or a world step has happened, or a
# window has passed. Later phases add their own variables here; the chronicle row reads only these three.
oe_bey_chr_void = { has_variable = oe_bey_gone }
oe_bey_chr_done = { has_variable = oe_bey_off }
oe_bey_chr_run = {
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_1
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_2
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_3
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_4
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_5
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_6
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_7
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w1 global_var:oe_bey_w1 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w2 global_var:oe_bey_w2 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w3 global_var:oe_bey_w3 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w4 global_var:oe_bey_w4 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w5 global_var:oe_bey_w5 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w6 global_var:oe_bey_w6 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w7 global_var:oe_bey_w7 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w8 global_var:oe_bey_w8 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w9 global_var:oe_bey_w9 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w10 global_var:oe_bey_w10 = 1 }
    }
}
